39936-meg-s-friend-a-story-for-girls.title: A Story for Girls.
39936-meg-s-friend-a-story-for-girls.creator: Alice Corkran,
39936-meg-s-friend-a-story-for-girls.description: A book by Alice Corkran,. Bloomsbury, that had been fashionable some two hundred years ago, and had fallen into abject neglect. The hall door was dim for want of paint, and weatherbeaten to a dirty gray; the lower windows were tawdry with vulgar blinds and curtains, and enlivened with green boxes full of a few pining flowers.

arxiv-2102-01931.title: A Global-local Attention Framework for Weakly Labelled Audio Tagging
arxiv-2102-01931.creator: Helin Wang, Yuexian Zou, Wenwu Wang
arxiv-2102-01931.description: Abstract Weakly labelled audio tagging aims to predict the classes of sound events within an audio clip, where the onset and offset times of the sound events are not provided. Previous works have used the multiple instance learning (MIL) framework, and exploited the information of the whole audio clip by MIL pooling functions.

arxiv-2211-00179.title: Noise and Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation in ”Underwater” Molecular Junctions
arxiv-2211-00179.creator: Henning Kirchberg, Abraham Nitzan
arxiv-2211-00179.description: Abstract We determine the zero-frequency charge current noise in a metal-molecule-metal junction embedded in a thermal environment, e.g., a solvent, dominated by sequential charge transmission described by a classical master equation, and study its dependence of specific model parameters, i.e., the environmental reorganization energy and relaxation behavior.

arxiv-2308-15592.title: Non-local Interactions are Essential Elements for Dark Matter Halo Stability: A Cross-Model Study
arxiv-2308-15592.creator: Ahmad Borzou 1,2
arxiv-2308-15592.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ahmad Borzou 1,2. This paper introduces a comprehensive methodology for examining the stability of dark matter (DM) halos, emphasizing the necessity for non-local inter-particle interactions, whether they are fundamental or effective in nature, to maintain halo stability. We highlight the inadequacy of vanilla cold collision-less DM models in forecasting a stable halo without considering a “non-local” interaction in the halo’s effective free energy, which could potentially arise from factors like baryonic feedback, self-interactions, or the intrinsic quantum characteristics of dark particles.

arxiv-2310-05671.title: Convexity and monotonicity of the probability mass function of the Poisson distribution of order k k Journal: (internal report CC23-8)
arxiv-2310-05671.creator: S. R. Mane
arxiv-2310-05671.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by S. R. Mane. This note focuses on the properties of two blocks of elements of the probability mass function (pmf) of the Poisson distribution of order k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 . The first block is the elements for n ∈ [ 1 , k ] n\in[1,k] and the second block is the elements for n ∈ [ k + 1 , 2 ​ k ] n\in[k+1,2k] .

arxiv-2402-11931.title: Soft-Weighted CrossEntropy Loss for Continous Alzheimer’s Disease Detection
arxiv-2402-11931.creator: Xiaohui Zhang, Mangui Liang, Wenjie Fu
arxiv-2402-11931.description: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease is a common cognitive disorder in the elderly. Early and accurate diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) has a major impact on the progress of research on dementia. At present, researchers have used machine learning methods to detect Alzheimer’s disease from the speech of participants.

arxiv-2405-17747.title: Discriminating between Babcock-Leighton-type solar dynamo models by torsional oscillations
arxiv-2405-17747.creator: Congyi Zhong, Jie Jiang, Zebin Zhang
arxiv-2405-17747.description: Abstract The details of the dynamo process in the Sun are an important aspect of research in solar-terrestrial physics and astrophysics. The surface part of the dynamo can be constrained by direct observations, but the subsurface part lacks direct observational constraints.

arxiv-2503-24144.title: 𝖯 {\mathsf{P}} -completeness of Graph Local Complementation
arxiv-2503-24144.creator: Pablo Concha-Vega
arxiv-2503-24144.description: Abstract Local complementation of a graph G G on vertex v v is an operation that results in a new graph G ∗ v G*v , where the neighborhood of v v is complemented. This operation has been widely studied in graph theory and quantum computing.

arxiv-2504-01102.title: Thermal Desorption Kinetics, Binding Energies, and Entrapment of Methyl Mercaptan Ices
arxiv-2504-01102.creator: Suchitra Narayanan, Elettra L. Piacentino, Karin I. Öberg, Mahesh Rajappan
arxiv-2504-01102.description: Abstract Organosulfur species are potential major carriers of sulfur in the interstellar medium, as well as interesting ingredients in prebiotic chemistry. The most fundamental question regarding these species is under which conditions they reside in the gas versus solid phase.

arxiv-2509-25552.title: Evaluating Foundation Models with Pathological Concept Learning for Kidney Cancer
arxiv-2509-25552.creator: Shangqi Gao, Sihan Wang, Yibo Gao, Boming Wang, Xiahai Zhuang, Anne Warren, Grant Stewart, James Jones, Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar
arxiv-2509-25552.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shangqi Gao, Sihan Wang, Yibo Gao, Boming Wang, Xiahai Zhuang, Anne Warren, Grant Stewart, James Jones, Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar. To evaluate the translational capabilities of foundation models, we develop a pathological concept learning approach focused on kidney cancer. By leveraging TNM staging guidelines and pathology reports, we build comprehensive pathological concepts for kidney cancer. Then, we extract deep features from whole slide images using foundation models, construct pathological graphs to capture spatial correlations, and trained graph neural networks to identify these concepts.

arxiv-2510-08120.title: Interpreting LLM-as-a-Judge Policies via Verifiable Global Explanations
arxiv-2510-08120.creator: Jasmina Gajcin, Erik Miehling, Rahul Nair, Elizabeth Daly, Radu Marinescu, Seshu Tirupathi
arxiv-2510-08120.description: Abstract Using LLMs to evaluate text, that is, LLM-as-a-judge, is increasingly being used at scale to augment or even replace human annotations. As such, it is imperative that we understand the potential biases and risks of doing so. In this work, we propose an approach for extracting high-level concept-based global policies from LLM-as-a-Judge.

arxiv-2511-17389.title: Frobenius Revivals in Laplacian Cellular Automata: Replication, Entropy, and Information Recovery
arxiv-2511-17389.creator: Małgorzata Nowak-Kępczyk
arxiv-2511-17389.description: Abstract We investigate Frobenius revivals in prime-modulus Laplacian cellular automata. The Frobenius identity yields exact superpositions of translated, coefficient-weighted seed copies at prime-power times; we distinguish this algebraic replication from their geometric separation. We investigate seed recovery from separated replicas and evaluate the correction of independent symbol errors introduced during transmission of encoded configurations.

Chronic social stress alters blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity through loss of tight junction protein claudin-5 (cldn5) in...

frus-1952-1954-iran-vol-10.creator: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
frus-1952-1954-iran-vol-10.source: U.S. Department of State (Office of the Historian)
frus-1952-1954-iran-vol-10.description: FRUS Volume X (1952–1954): the complete declassified documentary record of the 1953 Iran coup — the U.S.-British operation (TPAJAX) that overthrew Premier Mossadeq and restored the Shah. Public domain U.S. government work.

pmc-10635339.title: Using Address Data to Track Household Financial Burden of Disease
pmc-10635339.creator: Lauren Hersch Nicholas
pmc-10635339.description: The financial burden of illness cannot be correctly characterized without accounting for the impacts across healthy and sick members of a household. Currently, we have very few large, nationally representative data resources to facilitate such work. This paper describes ways to move the field forward through a novel application of address data.

pmc-11630908.title: Pod5Viewer: a GUI for inspecting raw nanopore sequencing data
pmc-11630908.creator: Vincent Dietrich, Nicolò Alagna, Mark Helm, Susanne Gerber, Tamer Butto, Can Alkan
pmc-11630908.description: MotivationOxford Nanopore Technologies recently adopted the POD5 file format for storing raw nanopore sequencing data. The information stored in these files provides detailed insights into the sequencing features and enhances the understanding of raw nanopore data. However, the process of visualizing the data can be cumbersome, especially for users without programming skills.

pmc-12427479.title: Parity influences on the infant gut microbiome development: a longitudinal cohort study
pmc-12427479.creator: R Prasad, A Angelova, P Subramanian, S Namasivayam, Q Chen, K Banks, S Levy, G L Maxwell, S K Hourigan
pmc-12427479.description: Parity, the number of pregnancies carried beyond 20 weeks, influences the maternal gut microbiome. However, whether parity modulates the infant microbiome longitudinally remains underexplored. To address this, 746 infants in a longitudinal cohort study were assessed. Serial infant stool samples collected at 2, 6, 12, and 24 months underwent 16S ribosomal RNA gene sequencing.

pmc-12583085.title: Phospholipase D1 is a critical mediator of neutrophil extracellular trap formation and venous thrombosis
pmc-12583085.creator: Ryosuke Aihara, Masatomo Takahashi, Kenji Morino, Keisuke Matsubara, Kazufumi Kunimura, Akihiko Nishikimi, Yoshihiro Izumi, Takeshi Bamba, Yoshinori Fukui, Takehito Uruno
pmc-12583085.description: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are a host defense mechanism whereby activated neutrophils release decondensed chromatin and antimicrobial proteins into the extracellular space to trap and kill invading pathogens. While effective in clearing pathogens, NETs also pose pathological risks by exposing self-DNA, histones, granular enzymes, and reactive oxygen species (ROS), contributing to pathologies such as autoimmune diseases, inflammatory disorders, and thrombosis.

pmc-13119421.title: The Role of an Herbal Preparation in Enhancing the Efficacy of Basic Therapy in Patients with Periodontitis: Evaluation of Clinical, Microbiological and Cytomorphometric Parameters
pmc-13119421.creator: Ivana Stanković, Radmila Obradović, Ana Pejčić, Dušanka Kitić, Milica Petrović, Boško Toljić, Marija Bradić-Vasić, Katarina Živadinović
pmc-13119421.description: Objectives: Periodontitis represents an inflammatory condition affecting the supporting structures of teeth. Basic therapy relies on scaling and root planning, but often fails to eliminate subgingival pathogens. Phytotherapy has emerged as an adjunct due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and tissue-protective properties.

pmc-13230887.title: Similarity study on lateral impact model of CFST column under high temperature
pmc-13230887.creator: Junjie Wang, Jianchun Xiao, Cong Liu, Yi Yang
pmc-13230887.description: This paper develops a finite element model of circular concrete-filled steel tube (CFST) columns subjected to combined high temperature and lateral impact using ABAQUS through sequential thermal-stress coupling analysis, static analysis, and explicit dynamic methods, and validates it with existing experimental data from fire resistance tests and impact tests.
